game.title: Gotham Knights
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG in which Batgirl, Robin, Nightwing and Red Hood protect Gotham City, from Warner Bros. Games Montréal, released 2022-10-21. RAWG average playtime: 5 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The Batman Family's case across Gotham City. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: The Batman Family
chapters.summary: Playing as all four heroes, reaching the maximum level and unlocking Momentum abilities and bars.

chapters.title: Gotham City: Collectibles and Side Goals
chapters.summary: Bruce Wayne's audio recordings, murals, landmarks, hidden Batarangs, Batcycle time trials and keeping Batman's identity secret.

chapters.title: Challenges, Training and Gear
chapters.summary: Challenges, the Training Area exercises, mod fusion and Legendary equipment sets.

chapters.title: Combat and Enemy Types
chapters.summary: Defeating Mob Godmothers, Regulator Shockers and Drone Masters, Freaks Bulldozers, and using Elemental Effects.

chapters.title: Supercharged Criminals
chapters.summary: Defeating Supercharged criminals and breaking them with Elemental Effect weaknesses.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for Gotham Knights (API returned missing for "Gotham Knights" and for "Gotham Knights (2022)"). gothamknights.fandom.com answers the API, with about 19 linked pages, including "Bat Family", "Belfry" and "Court of Owls"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Mercury" (an internal codename); the store list confirms app 1496790. 40 of 61 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. A block of hidden ones (49 to 58 and 60, for example "A Sophisticated Mallet" and "Showdown Sovereign") are earned by only about 2% of players, alongside the two visible Supercharged achievements (59 and 61), so they may belong to a later or harder mode, but nothing in the data says so. RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours, which looks low.
